ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),.
   B. Use Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), has no place in daily life.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Qur’an.
